products.name: Lilac Reverie
products.desc: Four lilac blossoms in clouded glass, ringed with zircon details and a single pavé centre. Each petal is finished by hand, so the colour catches light unevenly.

products.name: Serpentine Psalm
products.desc: A snake drawn in cloisonné wire, filled with pale turquoise and oxblood enamel, then fired three times at 780°C. Ruby glass drops hang from the coil and ring against the ear.

products.name: Morpho Nocturne
products.desc: An iridescent wing in layered resin, set into gold-tone filigree with a faceted black centre stone. The colour shifts from cobalt to green as the angle changes.

products.name: Nocturne of the Deep
products.desc: Four small sea-creature pins in recycled brass with a silver finish: a shell, a pearl-tone bead, a coral branch and a long filament form. Worn together as a nocturnal set.

products.name: Coral Reliquary
products.desc: Teardrops of coral-tone glass wrapped in gold-tone filigree, with a small blue-green resin cabochon at the crown and a pair of zircon drops.

products.name: Opaline Arch Cuff
products.desc: An open arch in gold-plated recycled brass, set with four opal-tone resin panels and a border of hand-set zircon. The articulated pins flex comfortably around the wrist.

products.name: Two Doves
products.desc: Two doves in silver-finish brass, turned toward one another around a faceted yellow-glass briolette. Pavé zircon traces the wings; the clasp hides in the tail of the left bird.
